So this commentator doesn’t like it when a potential Congressman burns the Quran for her belief and tries to expose her, even though Christians are actually being killed by people who believe in the Quran. but yet he won’t call those out, but I will.

Christians Under Attack Worldwide

Nigeria – The epicenter of Christian persecution.
•Over 3,000 Christians killed in 2023 alone, mostly by Boko Haram, Islamic State West Africa Province (ISWAP), and Fulani militants.
•Villages are burned, pastors kidnapped, churches destroyed.

Democratic Republic of Congo (North Kivu/Ituri) 
•ISIS-Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) massacre worshippers.
•July 2025: 38 Christians slaughtered near an evangelical church service; dozens more killed in nearby villages.

Syria (Damascus) 
•June 2025: A suicide bomber stormed Mar Elias Greek Orthodox Church during Sunday liturgy. 20+ worshippers killed. Claimed by ISIS.

Burkina Faso –
•February 2024: Gunmen stormed Catholic Mass in Essakane, killing 15. Responsibility: Islamist insurgents linked to al-Qaeda/ISIS.

Philippines (Marawi) 
•December 2023: ISIS-linked militants bombed a Catholic Mass, killing 4, wounding dozens.

Pakistan 
•2024: Christian man Nazir Masih, beaten to death by a mob after a false blasphemy claim. No justice served.

Open Doors & USCIRF data:
•4,476 Christians killed worldwide last year.
•3,100 of those in Nigeria alone.
•Perpetrators are overwhelmingly Islamist extremist groups.

Fact: Around the world, Christians are being murdered for their faith and the killers are groups operating under the banner of the Quran. 

Don’t ignore it. Speak up. Pray. Demand accountability. Support those under fire.

@TigTiegen
